sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Kit bundle – counter-proposal on price and term (Angebot offer:70610-1)
move.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for revising to €5.63 in offer:70610-1. We want to consolidate the complete kit with you; part:360012 already runs at 30% with sup:70610, and a standard lead time of 5 days (sup:70610) fits our line.

A 12-month term brings no consolidation benefit and leaves the kit exposed. A 24–36 month commitment gives you stable volume and fewer order cycles.

Could you send a cost breakdown (material, logistics, handling) and confirm whether a longer term changes your price?

Our proposals: 1) €5.45, 30 days, 24 months; 2) €5.39, 30 days, 36 months; 3) €5.62, 60 days, 36 months.

Looking forward to your reply.

Best regards

move.text:
Dear customer,

We can accept your terms and await your order. Our offer stands at a price of €5.62 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We welcome your intention to consolidate the kit and confirm that a longer contract term allows us to adjust the price. However, the rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to?

Please understand that as a distributor, we do not share internal cost breakdowns, as our pricing reflects the complete value of our inventory and logistics services. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
